what: The report half of an Impact answer, as one committed set of inputs and the exact sentence each one must produce.
why: Astra's ruling 2 on the 653f741c build: the two doors already drifted. The engine called a stale reading
'not been checked' while the page said it needed checking again, which is a difference in MEANING, not a
difference in clock formatting. The engine also named EVERY checked report in a hit sentence when only
some of them contained the field.
This file is read independently by Semanticus.Tests/ReportScopeRejectionTests.cs and by
Semanticus.VSCode/test/impact-one-page.test.mjs. Neither suite builds the other and neither compares a
localized clock string: times are supplied here already formatted, because a time is the one part that is
genuinely the reader's own and is not what drifted.

cases.name: nothing chosen
cases.reportSentence: Report use is unknown. No reports have been chosen for this model yet.

cases.name: chosen, none read
cases.reportSentence: Report use is unknown. The chosen reports still need checking.

cases.name: a reading the model has moved past
cases.reportSentence: Report use needs checking again. The model changed after 1 listed report was read.

cases.name: two read, only one contains the field
cases.reportSentence: Total Sales or something that depends on it appears in 1 checked report (Warehouse ops). The other checked report does not use it.

cases.name: read and not used anywhere
cases.reportSentence: No use of Total Sales or the things that depend on it was found in the 1 report checked (Warehouse ops).

cases.name: one read, one still to read
cases.reportSentence: No use of Total Sales or the things that depend on it was found in the 1 report checked (Warehouse ops). 1 listed report was not checked.

cases.name: one read, one could not be fully read
cases.reportSentence: No use of Total Sales or the things that depend on it was found in the 1 report checked (Warehouse ops). 1 listed report could not be fully checked.
